pages.title: About Us
pages.seo_title: About Us | Right Standard Contracting Company
pages.seo_description: Explore the Right Standard Contracting Company, where we elevate construction standards and deliver unmatched quality in Saudi Arabia.
pages.body:
where we elevate construction standards to deliver excellence and unmatched quality.

With over a decade of experience in executing critical government projects across Saudi Arabia, this company was founded with a clear vision: to provide comprehensive contracting and engineering solutions that not only meet the highest standards but consistently exceed client expectations.

Our focus lies in serving government entities, large corporations, and medium-sized enterprises. We approach every project with passion, precision, and unwavering commitment, ensuring efficiency and superior quality at every stage.

As a proud holder (Praise to ALLAH ) of the Saudi Permanent Premium Residency (Business Investor Category), we are deeply committed to contributing to the growth of the Kingdom’s contracting sector. We strive to foster innovation, promote sustainability, and align our efforts with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 to help build a stronger, more sustainable future.

At Right Standard Contracting Company, we don’t just construct projects—we build lasting partnerships. We look forward to collaborating with you to achieve new milestones together.

Right Standard
Your Right decision.

Engr. Abdallah Nazir Halawani
Founder & CEO

data.title: Welcome to Right Standard Contracting Company

tabs.title: Our Mission
tabs.html:
To provide superior construction solutions with excellence, integrity, and client satisfaction. We deliver projects on time, within budget, and to the highest standards, building strong,
long-lasting relationships with clients and partners.

tabs.title: Our Vision
tabs.html: To be Saudi Arabia’s top choice for innovative and high-quality construction, setting new standards and contributing to community growth through sustainable infrastructure.

tabs.title: Our Value
tabs.html:
1)Integrity: Honest, transparent, and ethical practices.
2)Quality: High standards and continuous improvement.
3)Innovation:Embracing new technologies and creative solutions.
4)Safety: Prioritizing the well-being of everyone involved.
5)Customer Focus: Tailoring solutions to meet and exceed client expectations.
6)Sustainability: Committed to environmentally responsible practices.
